name: Detailed Thinkers
definition: Disrupting a competitive industry requires radical, detailed thinking. Communicate a daring direction, love the details, and keep a contagious desire for knowledge.

rows.situation: When you set an ambitious direction
rows.under: States the ambition, and leaves the details to whoever is unlucky.
rows.justRight: Communicates the daring direction, and knows the details well enough to say whether it is possible.
rows.over: Gets so deep into the details that nobody can see where you are going.

rows.situation: When you are asked how your area works
rows.under: Quotes the summary someone else prepared.
rows.justRight: Knows the numbers cold, including what they exclude, because you have looked yourself.
rows.over: Answers every question at a level of detail that stops the meeting from deciding anything.

rows.situation: When the work is expensive to redo
rows.under: Starts building, and discovers the problem at integration.
rows.justRight: Thinks it through until the expensive mistakes are visible on paper, then builds.
rows.over: Plans until the market has moved, and the plan is about a world that has gone.

rows.situation: When the edge case is rare
rows.under: Ignores it. Rare means it will not happen to you.
rows.justRight: Works out what it costs when it does happen, and handles it if that cost is real.
rows.over: Handles every edge case up front, and the common path arrives a quarter late.

rows.situation: When you review someone else's detailed work
rows.justRight: Reads it properly, and asks the questions that only appear at that depth.
rows.over: Rewrites their work in your own style, and calls it a review.
